data.name: CR5_A01
data.value: I think we're getting close to the ruins...

data.name: CR5_A02
data.value: We're almost there...[pause=20] According to the map...

data.name: CR5_A03
data.value: ...Is this really it?[pause=20] There's nothing.[pause=10] No fire,[pause=10] no tents.

data.name: CR5_A04
data.value: (Nobody got here before us?[pause=15] But they left first...)

data.name: CR5_A05
data.value: Ah...[pause=20] Plum?[pause=15] How are you doing?

data.name: CR5_A06
data.value: I was just thinking about you...

data.name: CR5_A07
data.value: (...How did she get here?[pause=15] She was way behind us not long ago...)

data.name: CR5_A08
data.value: ...Plum?

data.name: CR5_A09
data.value: The survey was correct.[pause=15] This is the place.

data.name: CR5_A10
data.value: My roots...[pause=20] Next time,[pause=10] someone else carries the supplies.

data.name: CR5_A11
data.value: Nobody sits down before I've checked their feet.[pause=15] That's an order.

data.name: CR5_A12
data.value: You're already here?![pause=20] But we left before you!

data.name: CR5_A13
data.value: The wind comes from the ruins.[pause=15] It smells of nothing.[pause=10] Not even dust.

data.name: CR5_A14
data.value: For once,[pause=10] I'm not last![pause=15] Mark the date.

data.name: CR5_A15
data.value: My legs stopped talking to me.[pause=20] They left at the third pass.

data.name: CR5_A16
data.value: You walked two hours.[pause=15] I carried your bag.

data.name: CR5_A17
data.value: ...and I swear, the ledge gave way RIGHT UNDER MY FEET!

data.name: CR5_A18
data.value: You jumped. I saw you. You jumped before it gave way.

data.name: CR5_A19
data.value: Same thing![pause=15] The danger was REAL!

data.name: CR5_A20
data.value: Kino.[pause=20] Kino, look ahead of you.

data.name: CR5_A21
data.value: She hasn't moved since we arrived...[pause=15] Maybe she walked too far.

data.name: CR5_A22
data.value: Or she's setting something up.[pause=15] She always does that before a prank.

data.name: CR5_A23
data.value: ...Did we do something wrong?

data.name: CR5_A24
data.value: Give her time.[pause=20] Everyone carries exhaustion their own way.

data.name: CR5_A25
data.value: (Since we got here...[pause=15] Plum hasn't said a single word...[pause=20] What's wrong with her?)

data.name: CR5_A26
data.value: YOOOOOOOOU LOOOOOOOOST MEEEEEE!!!

data.name: CR5_A27
data.value: ...We did not lose you.[pause=20] You were not on the expedition roster.

data.name: CR5_A28
data.value: EXACTLY![pause=15] You didn't even LOOK for me!

data.name: CR5_A29
data.value: You can't lose someone you never brought along,[pause=10] Plum.

data.name: CR5_A30
data.value: That's WORSE![pause=20] You lost me BEFORE leaving!

data.name: CR5_A31
data.value: Technically,[pause=10] you arrived before us.[pause=20] We were the lost ones.

data.name: CR5_A32
data.value: ...I took the shortcut.[pause=20] There's a shortcut.[pause=15] You didn't take it.

data.name: CR5_A33
data.value: THERE WAS A SHORTCUT?!

data.name: CR5_A34
data.value: I would have told you![pause=20] IF YOU'D BROUGHT ME ALONG!

data.name: CR5_A35
data.value: (...I think she won.)

data.name: CR5_A36
data.value: So.[pause=20] Do we eat?

data.name: CR5_A37
data.value: Three seconds.[pause=15] He lasted three seconds.

data.name: CR5_A38
data.value: That's a record![pause=15] Yesterday it was two!

data.name: CR5_A39
data.value: I carried the supplies ALL DAY![pause=15] I have every right to—

data.name: CR5_A40
data.value: ...We eat whenever you like.[pause=20] No rush.

data.name: CR5_A41
data.value: (...She didn't even have to speak...)

data.name: CR5_A42
data.value: The fire catches.[pause=20] The camp finally settles in.

data.name: CR5_A43
data.value: Tomorrow,[pause=10] at dawn,[pause=10] we go in.[pause=20] Tonight,[pause=10] we eat and we talk.

data.name: CR5_A44
data.value: ...and the ledge gave way.[pause=15] I STAND BY IT.

data.name: CR5_A45
data.value: He'll stand by it until the world ends.

data.name: CR5_A46
data.value: Here,[pause=10] both of you eat this.[pause=15] You look hollow.

data.name: CR5_A47
data.value: I took the shortcut.[pause=20] I'M well rested.

data.name: CR5_A48
data.value: She's never going to drop this shortcut thing.

data.name: CR5_A49
data.value: The wind died down.[pause=15] First time in three days.

data.name: CR5_A50
data.value: The ruins are split in two.[pause=20] Whatever opened them didn't come from outside.

data.name: CR5_A51
data.value: Then we'll look from the inside.[pause=15] Together.

data.name: CR5_A52
data.value: (It's the first time the whole expedition really talked.[pause=15] That matters.)

data.name: CR5_A53
data.value: Night falls over the camp.[pause=20] Time to sleep.

data.name: CR5_A54
data.value: ...Rin?[pause=15] Are you asleep?

data.name: CR5_A55
data.value: No.[pause=20] But I'm going to pretend.

data.name: CR5_A56
data.value: Hyko,[pause=10] you're already snoring.[pause=15] That's physically impossible.

data.name: CR5_A57
data.value: Reinier.[pause=15] Reinier.[pause=20] It REALLY gave way.

data.name: CR5_A58
data.value: Sleep.

data.name: CR5_A59
data.value: I'm just saying that—

data.name: CR5_A60
data.value: Everyone sleeps.[pause=20] Kino,[pause=10] that includes you.[pause=15] Just like Mount Windswept.

data.name: CR5_A61
data.value: ...Understood.

data.name: CR5_A62
data.value: And nobody wakes up and leaves without me.

data.name: CR5_A63
data.value: Hey...[pause=20] You're not asleep either,[pause=10] are you?

data.name: CR5_A64
data.value: (...No.[pause=15] I'm thinking about tomorrow.)

data.name: CR5_A65
data.value: Me too.[pause=20] But we got past Mount Windswept.[pause=15] We'll get past this too.

data.name: CR5_A66
data.value: Good night.[pause=20] Really.

data.name: CR5_A67
data.value: Good night, everyone.[pause=20] Tomorrow belongs to us.

data.name: CR5_A68
data.value: The next morning...

data.name: CR5_A69
data.value: ...Is it already time?[pause=20] I slept three minutes.

data.name: CR5_A70
data.value: I slept great![pause=15] I dreamt about the ledge.

data.name: CR5_A71
data.value: The bedrolls are packed away.[pause=20] The camp gathers.

data.name: CR5_A72
data.value: Here we are.[pause=20] Three days of marching for this door.

data.name: CR5_A73
data.value: I won't ask you to be brave.[pause=20] I'm asking you to come back.[pause=15] All of you.

data.name: CR5_A74
data.value: Guild,[pause=10] move out![pause=20] The Cloven Ruins await!

data.name: CR5_A75
data.value: Let's go.[pause=20] Stay close to me,[pause=10] okay?

data.name: CR5_A76
data.value: Don't move.[pause=20] You made it back,[pause=10] that's already a lot.

data.name: CR5_A77
data.value: The Ruins pushed you back.[pause=20] Rest.[pause=15] They aren't going anywhere.

data.name: CR5_A78
data.value: You were right to come back up.[pause=20] Forcing it would have led nowhere.

data.name: CR5_A79
data.value: Turning back in time is a decision,[pause=10] not a failure.

data.name: CR5_A80
data.value: She's not trying to go in.[pause=15] She's waiting for us.

data.name: CR5_A81
data.value: And she's saying nothing.[pause=15] That's worse.

data.name: CR5_A82
data.value: The ground has been disturbed by the door.[pause=15] Stay in the clearing.

data.name: CR5_A83
data.value: We make camp here.[pause=15] No one crosses that door alone.

data.name: CR5_A84
data.value: I want to check everyone's paws before dinner.

data.name: CR5_A85
data.value: Someone knows a shortcut.[pause=15] And someone forgot to tell us.

data.name: CR5_A86
data.value: I'll take first watch.

data.name: CR5_A87
data.value: I'll take second.[pause=15] It looks less bitey.

data.name: CR5_A88
data.value: At least she's in one piece.[pause=15] That's already good news.

data.name: CR5_A89
data.value: Tornadus is behind us.[pause=15] Don't let its fear walk with us.

data.name: CR5_A90
data.value: We did it together.[pause=15] We'll do the same tomorrow.

data.name: CR5_A91
data.value: The ruins owe us nothing.[pause=15] We owe them caution.

data.name: CR5_A92
data.value: I'll sleep after I check the perimeter.

data.name: CR5_A93
data.value: You don't sleep,[pause=10] you count problems.

data.name: CR5_A94
data.value: I'm very good at counting them.

data.name: CR5_A95
data.value: This time,[pause=10] nobody leaves without warning us.

data.name: CR5_A96
data.value: Promise.[pause=15] Well...[pause=10] I'll try.

data.name: CR5_A97
data.value: Tomorrow, we stay together until the door.[pause=15] After that, we adapt.

data.name: CR5_A98
data.value: The cave is too quiet.[pause=15] Keep your voices low near the door.

data.name: CR5_A99
data.value: Understood.[pause=15] Even Ganlon?

data.name: CR5_A100
data.value: Especially Ganlon.

data.name: CR5_A101
data.value: I saved water for morning.[pause=15] No arguments.

data.name: CR5_A102
data.value: Noted.[pause=15] By someone other than me, anyway.

data.name: CR5_A103
data.value: We beat Tornadus because we listened to each other.

data.name: CR5_A104
data.value: Then tomorrow,[pause=10] we start with that.

data.name: CR5_A105
data.value: If something goes wrong,[pause=10] we fall back together.

data.name: CR5_A106
data.value: No lone hero.[pause=15] No lone straggler.

data.name: CR5_A107
data.value: I heard that second part.

data.name: CR5_A108
data.value: That was the point.

data.name: CR5_A109
data.value: The fire is dying down.[pause=15] Save some of yourselves for tomorrow.

data.name: CR5_A110
data.value: Good idea.[pause=15] I'll start with my eyes.

data.name: CR5_A111
data.value: You've had them closed for an hour.

data.name: CR5_A112
data.value: I'm practising.

data.name: CR5_A113
data.value: When daylight comes,[pause=10] nobody leaves camp without telling Penticus.

data.name: CR5_A114
data.value: Even for a shortcut?

data.name: CR5_A115
data.value: Especially for a shortcut.

data.name: CR5_A116
data.value: We can do this.[pause=15] But not by forgetting why we came.

data.name: CR5_A117
data.value: Together.[pause=15] All the way.

data.name: CR5_A118
data.value: (How long has she been here?[pause=15] And why wait in front of that door?)

data.name: CR5_A119
data.value: She heard us arrive.[pause=15] Look at her ears.

data.name: CR5_A120
data.value: I prefer it when she sings.

data.name: CR5_A121
data.value: We don't press her.[pause=15] Not now.

data.name: CR5_A122
data.value: Okay.[pause=15] But I'm staying close to you.

data.name: CR5_A123
data.value: The tracks stop here.[pause=15] The wind nearly erased them.

data.name: CR5_A124
data.value: Then we'll replace them with ours.[pause=15] Together.

data.name: CR5_A125
data.value: No serious injuries.[pause=15] Just fatigue and stubborn paws.

data.name: CR5_A126
data.value: Mine are protesting with great dignity.

data.name: CR5_A127
data.value: They're mostly protesting very loudly.

data.name: CR5_A128
data.value: The door hasn't moved.[pause=15] That's what worries me.

data.name: CR5_A129
data.value: We still have time to look before we decide.

data.name: CR5_A130
data.value: And to eat before looking.[pause=15] That's a very sensible decision.

data.name: CR5_A131
data.value: There you all are.[pause=15] Good. Now I can complain properly.

data.name: CR5_A132
data.value: So that's the shortcut:[pause=10] arrive before everyone and scare the first group.

data.name: CR5_A133
data.value: I didn't scare anyone.[pause=15] You did that yourselves.

data.name: CR5_A134
data.value: She has a point.

data.name: CR5_A135
data.value: Don't encourage her.

data.name: CR5_A136
data.value: Too late.[pause=15] She's already gained confidence.

data.name: CR5_A137
data.value: Tornadus separated us once.[pause=15] Not twice.

data.name: CR5_A138
data.value: Then tomorrow,[pause=10] everyone keeps someone in sight.

data.name: CR5_A139
data.value: I can do that.[pause=15] Especially if someone watches Ganlon too.

data.name: CR5_A140
data.value: I'm right here.

data.name: CR5_A141
data.value: That's precisely what makes the plan possible.

data.name: CR5_A142
data.value: The ruins have stood for a long time.[pause=15] They can wait one more night.

data.name: CR5_A143
data.value: And we'll be better after a night.

data.name: CR5_A144
data.value: Even you?

data.name: CR5_A145
data.value: Especially me.

data.name: CR5_A146
data.value: Fine.[pause=15] I'm saving that line for tomorrow morning.

data.name: CR5_A147
data.value: The wind changed.[pause=15] It's coming from the door now.

data.name: CR5_A148
data.value: Then keep it outside.[pause=15] Tonight, the camp is ours.

data.name: CR5_A149
data.value: Do you think she's asleep already?

data.name: CR5_A150
data.value: Plum?[pause=15] No.[pause=10] She's probably preparing revenge.

data.name: CR5_A151
data.value: I can hear you.

data.name: CR5_A152
data.value: See?[pause=15] Exactly what I was saying.

data.name: CR5_A153
data.value: If the dream comes back,[pause=10] wake me.

data.name: CR5_A154
data.value: I'll be there.[pause=15] Even if you can't find the words.

data.name: CR5_A155
data.value: Did you sleep at all?

data.name: CR5_A156
data.value: Enough to know we need tea.

data.name: CR5_A157
data.value: Before the door,[pause=10] we check bags, paws, and pairs.

data.name: CR5_A158
data.value: I like pairs.[pause=15] They're easier not to lose.

data.name: CR5_A159
data.value: Plum.

data.name: CR5_A160
data.value: What?[pause=15] It's a very practical rule.

data.name: CR5_A161
data.value: We move together.[pause=15] And we come back together.
